title: Australian Tax Rates 2024-25 Overview
content: Tax rates for Australian residents for the full tax year 2024-25. These rates do not include the Medicare levy of 2%. Individuals must be entitled to the full tax-free threshold. Use ATO calculator tools for accurate calculations including Medicare levy and other applicable charges.

title: Tax-Free Threshold 2024-25: $0 - $18,200
content: Income from $0 to $18,200 is tax-free for Australian residents in 2024-25. This is the tax-free threshold and no income tax is payable on earnings up to this amount. You can only claim the full tax-free threshold from one employer if you have multiple jobs.

title: Tax Rate 2024-25: $18,201 - $45,000
content: Income between $18,201 and $45,000 is taxed at 16 cents for each dollar over $18,200 in 2024-25. For example, on income of $30,000, you pay 16% on $11,800 ($30,000 - $18,200) which equals $1,888 in tax before Medicare levy.

title: Tax Rate 2024-25: $45,001 - $135,000
content: Income between $45,001 and $135,000 pays $4,288 plus 30 cents for each dollar over $45,000 in 2024-25. This bracket covers middle to higher income earners. For example, on income of $80,000, you pay $4,288 + (30% × $35,000) = $14,788 in tax before Medicare levy.

title: Tax Rate 2024-25: $135,001 - $190,000
content: Income between $135,001 and $190,000 pays $31,288 plus 37 cents for each dollar over $135,000 in 2024-25. This is the second-highest tax bracket for high income earners. For example, on income of $150,000, you pay $31,288 + (37% × $15,000) = $36,838 in tax before Medicare levy.

title: Top Tax Rate 2024-25: $190,001 and over
content: Income of $190,001 and over pays $51,638 plus 45 cents for each dollar over $190,000 in 2024-25. This is the highest marginal tax rate for very high income earners. For example, on income of $250,000, you pay $51,638 + (45% × $60,000) = $78,638 in tax before Medicare levy.

title: Medicare Levy Not Included in Tax Rates 2024-25
content: The tax rates shown for 2024-25 do not include the Medicare levy, which is typically 2% of taxable income. Medicare levy and Medicare levy surcharge (if applicable) are calculated separately and added to your income tax. Use ATO calculators for total tax including Medicare components.
